name: teams-for-linux-mcp
description: Teams Office source, documentation and integration with Teams for Linux

scripts.install:app: npm run prepare:app && npm --prefix build/teams-office ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:build && npm run test:unit
scripts.lint: npm run prepare:app && build/teams-office/node_modules/.bin/eslint --config eslint.config.mjs scripts tools src tests test && npm --prefix build/teams-office run lint
